description:
Get the full configuration of one reminder as JSON.

    Use when you need detail that list_reminders omits — the exact spoken message,
    cron expression, skip dates, channel toggles, or voice override. Also use this to
    read current values before a partial update, so you don't overwrite settings.

    Args:
        reminder_id: Reminder ID from list_reminders.
name: get_reminder
title: Get reminder details
